budget.rationale: The published budget, unreduced, for every searched target. The roster's eight cells have eleven targets, so two seeds make 22 searches and 220,000 samples, about 55,000 requests. Each target is searched by its own process, all at once; at the budget pilot's pace on 2026-10-08, about 206 samples an hour, a search takes about two days.

prompt_policy.description: LLM-SR specifications natively embed a problem description, so supplying the public task specification matches its own protocol.

scope_note: The eight Phase C roster cells with two seeds. Every LLM-SR setting is its own default: 10 islands, 4 samples per prompt, a 30-second evaluation timeout and a 4-hour island reset. The model kept is LLM-SR's own choice, the sample its evaluator scored highest on the training derivatives.

reasoning_model_adaptation.rationale: LLM-SR was published with models that answer at once. gpt-oss reasons before it answers, within the same token limit, and writes its function header over several lines. Measured on 2026-10-05 by sending this cell's first LLM-SR prompt as a chat message to the hosted gpt-oss-120b, four samples per request: at upstream's 512 new tokens all four stopped at the limit while still reasoning; at 4096 all four finished, at low and at the served default reasoning effort (about 2,200 tokens per sample at the default), but every one split its header, which upstream's reader (sampler._extract_body) takes as the start of the body, so its trimming kept nothing; with the header read as one line, all four were usable, at either effort. Sampling controls, reasoning effort included, stay at the served defaults, as upstream leaves them unset.
